title: FederationTrust
description: Operator-configured peer trust anchor. The peer owns its agents; tenant is always the local request scope and must never be mapped from peer claims.

tenant_id.description: Server-scoped tenant. A caller-supplied value is discarded.

issuer.description: Absolute https issuer URI of the peer. Plain http is only accepted for loopback development endpoints; must not be the local authority.

jwks_uri.description: Peer JWKS endpoint used to verify peer signatures. https required except loopback.

claim_mappings.description: Normalized field to external claim. agent_id is required; tenant_id must not be mapped (the server rejects it).

allowed_audiences.description: Local audiences for which peer tokens may be introspected active.
